sampling.unit: independent VAE/SAE training seed (init, minibatch order, reparameterization noise; run RNG seed derived from sha256(cell_id|seed))
sampling.per_cell: sweep_grid.json lists the confirmation seeds of every cell
sampling.justification: 5 seeds for the 18 raw-state (A1/A2/A4) bw-gauss_vae cells (core of H2.2/H2.3 and the comparators of pw03 H3.2 and pw04 H4.1/H4.2); 3 for controls, secondary families and activation cells (budget). Claims use a fixed 2-unit tolerance plus non-overlap of seed ranges. Transformer sources are fixed substrates; width 128 is replicated over three exp46 seeds (s1-s3), widths 64/256 use s1 only.

uncertainty: All per-seed counts reported; seed medians and ranges per cell (passing seeds only for required cells); differences claimed only beyond 2 units with non-overlapping seed ranges. With 5 seeds the within-cell range is a stricter yardstick for H2.3 than with 3 (expected range of 5 vs 3 normal draws: 2.33 vs 1.69 sd). Complete separation of 5 vs 5 seeds has exact one-sided permutation p = 1/252, 5 vs 3 p = 1/56, 3 vs 3 p = 1/20 (reported, not used as criteria). Descriptive two-way variance decomposition (arch, lr; residual = seed). No p-value criteria.

splits.development: thesis blocksworld_train file split by sequence with seed 0 into train (12,803) and val (3,201); (b) subsamples 3,000 train and 500 val sequences
splits.confirmation: thesis blocksworld_test file (4,001 sequences; (b) uses a fixed 300-sequence subsample), sealed until the full run; on raw states the support is identical across splits, so independent seeds 1-5 / 1-3 (vs pilot seed 101) are the effective confirmation unit

selection_rule: No selection: every cell's final checkpoint at step 60,000 is analyzed; no early stopping, no best-seed choice, thresholds fixed in advance.
stopping_rule: Per-run crash/NaN: one same-seed re-run, logged; second failure = technical stop for that run. Experiment-level competence_stop if any cell entering a required criterion has fewer than a majority of its planned seeds passing competence. One re-pilot under this amendment (pilot_001, seed 101, 20 cells, development data); any gate or convergence-check failure not covered by this amendment stops the experiment; no further amendments.
controls: code10 data (10 independent bits, redundantly coded): positive control with known count
prod5 data (5 independent 6-valued one-hot blocks): same per-block coding and affine dim as Blocksworld, no legality constraints
indep data (independent bits with Blocksworld marginals): no-structure negative control
plain autoencoder: AU-metric control (no KL term)
PCA counts on every substrate: linear baseline
fixed-gamma Gaussian decoder vs learned gamma on (b), 5 source checkpoints
b_lin (state-explained activations) vs b_raw: non-state content control
grid: experiments/pw02a_active_units_amended/sweep_grid.json (58 cells, 210 confirmation runs: 18 cells x 5 seeds + 40 cells x 3 seeds; 20 pilot cells at seed 101)
